The deviation of a single tap = actual tap time − standard beat time (positive means late, negative means early), and the mean deviation = Σ deviation ÷ count. Steadiness can be measured by the standard deviation of the deviations, with a standard deviation below 30 ms considered stable. The beat interval = 60000 ÷ BPM milliseconds, so 120 BPM gives 500 ms.
